## Role in the Rating Process

The European Investment Bank has a limited direct role in the minimal rating process. Its lending to sovereigns or state-owned entities can appear as official, off-market financing. This affects the assessment of the portion of debt not exposed to market conditions, which is a discretionary adjustment under the refinancing need parameter (`[Refinancing Need](../parameters/refinancing-need.qmd)`, specifically the R1-A task).

### [Belgium](../countries/belgium.qmd)

- The European Investment Bank provides funding for various projects in Belgium, including energy efficiency renovations, sustainable transport, and social housing. For instance, Brussels received EUR 475 million from the European Investment Bank for electric buses and metro and tram sets. <button type="button" class="source-ref" data-source="ec/country-reports/Belgium_2026-06-03, p. 72" aria-label="Source: ec/country-reports/Belgium_2026-06-03, p. 72">ⓘ</button>
